open_subjects.synthetic: {form} warming up on a table, softly glowing dials and tubes, warm filament glow in natural light
open_subjects.announcer: {form} in a modest broadcast booth, glowing warmly, lit dials and tubes under natural light
open_subjects.default: {form} glowing warmly, aged vacuum tubes and worn dials

motion_registers.announcer: Continuous shot, same console throughout. Tuning dial needle drifts steadily. Tubes glow and breathe. Dust motes float in window light. Slow deliberate dolly forward.
motion_registers.music_open: Continuous shot, same console throughout. Dial sweeps across frequencies. Tube filaments warm from cold to bright. Grille cloth trembles gently. Measured dolly push forward.
motion_registers.music_close: Continuous shot, same console throughout. Dial settles. Tube filaments fade through deep amber. A last curl of dust drifts down. Slow dolly pull back.
motion_registers.music_inter: Continuous shot, same console throughout. Dial steady, glowing. Needle quivers with the rhythm. Tubes pulse softly. Slow orbit around the speaker.
